14.1.title: Iridium System Link Margin Analysis
14.1.title_cn: 铱星系统链路余量分析
14.1.description: The Iridium satellite communication system was designed with a link margin of 16 dB, and was originally advertised as being capable of providing service to users with hand-held phones in vehicles, buildings, and urban areas. Today, after bankruptcy and restructuring, it is recommended that Iridium phones be used outdoors with line of sight. Estimate link margins required for L-band communications into vehicles and buildings. Would Iridium operate reliably? Why was 16 dB chosen?
14.1.description_cn: 铱星卫星通信系统设计链路余量16 dB，最初宣传可服务车辆、建筑、城市区域手持用户。如今建议户外视距使用。估算L波段进入车辆和建筑所需链路余量。系统能否可靠运行？为何设计16 dB余量？

designed_margin.description: Designed link margin of Iridium system

steps.title: Required Link Margins by Environment
steps.title_cn: 不同环境所需链路余量
steps.formula_cn: 户外视距: 0-3 dB, 车辆内: 6-10 dB, 建筑内: 10-25 dB, 城区: 20-30 dB
